name: rust-discovery-exclusions
body: Manifest discovery must not descend into generated, dependency, or other-tree directories: target/, vendor/, node_modules/, and .worktrees/ are never scan roots. In particular the generated build artifacts under src/rustlib/target/**/out/*.rs must not be scanned as source. AC: a fixture with a generated .rs under target/ produces no code node for it, and a nested Cargo project under .worktrees/ is not discovered.
